scientific_integrity: The finite search and seed checks are reproducible from verify.py. The universal assertions are supported by the written proof and are not inferred from enumeration. The four primitive seeds and the weird number 70 are previously known individually; the assessed contribution is a complete all-exponent classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly three distinct prime factors with 2-adic valuation one. Prior OEIS sequences contain the small seeds, and the 1974 foundational paper predates the precisely dated 2005 sequence anchor (its publication is documented to month rather than exact day). Historical unindexed priority remains possible. The mathematical proof is complete for the stated domain; finite computational checks are auxiliary.
title: Semiperfectness and weirdness for three-prime integers with a single factor of two
